subject: redirect defaults to 303
claim: `flask.helpers.redirect` builds the redirect response and defaults `code` to 302, delegating to `current_app.redirect` when an application context is active.
truth: The default status code changed from 302 to 303.

subject: case-insensitive comparison
claim: `flask.sansio.app.App.select_jinja_autoescape` decides autoescaping from the template's extension and compares it exactly, so a file named `INDEX.HTML` is not autoescaped.
truth: The comparison now lowercases the filename first, so uppercase extensions are autoescaped too.

subject: separate copy per call
claim: `flask.ctx.copy_current_request_context` copies the active context once, at decoration time, and the wrapped function always runs inside that single shared copy.
truth: The copy is now made inside the wrapper, so each call gets its own context.

subject: use __init_subclass__ instead of metaclass for MethodView
claim: `flask.views.MethodView` collects the HTTP methods a view implements through the `flask.views.MethodViewType` metaclass.
truth: MethodViewType was deleted; MethodView now uses __init_subclass__.

subject: session expiration datetime is UTC timezone-aware
claim: `flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_expiration_time` returns a naive UTC datetime built from `datetime.utcnow`, or `None` when the session is not permanent.
truth: get_expiration_time now returns a timezone-aware datetime via datetime.now(timezone.utc).

subject: require a non-empty name for blueprints
claim: `flask.blueprints.Blueprint` rejects a name containing a dot, but accepts an empty name.
truth: An empty blueprint name now raises ValueError.

subject: all teardown callbacks are called despite errors
claim: `flask.app.Flask.do_teardown_request` runs the teardown callbacks in reverse registration order and stops at the first one that raises.
truth: Every teardown callback now runs; errors are collected and raised together.

subject: fix subdomain_matching=False behavior
claim: `flask.app.Flask.create_url_adapter` ignores the configured server name when it chooses a subdomain: with `subdomain_matching` off it always uses `url_map.default_subdomain`.
truth: The subdomain is now derived from SERVER_NAME when that is set; default_subdomain is only the fallback.

subject: add encoding parameter to open_resource
claim: `flask.app.Flask.open_resource` takes only the resource path and a `mode`; text mode uses the platform default and the caller cannot override it.
truth: open_resource gained an encoding parameter, used in text mode.

subject: Allow for PathLike types for config file variables
claim: `flask.config.Config.from_pyfile` requires its `filename` to be a `str`, so a path object has to be converted before it is passed in.
truth: from_pyfile now accepts str | os.PathLike.

subject: no cookie domain by default
claim: `flask.sessions.SessionInterface.get_cookie_domain` uses `SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN` when it is configured and otherwise falls back to detecting the domain from `SERVER_NAME`.
truth: The SERVER_NAME fallback was removed; the domain comes from SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN alone.

subject: view functions can return generators as responses directly
claim: `flask.app.Flask.make_response` documents the return types a view may use: `str`, `bytes`, `dict`, `tuple`, `Response`, and a WSGI callable. A lazily produced body has to be wrapped in a `Response` by the view itself.
truth: A generator returned from a view is now converted to a streaming response.

subject: type hint fix for flask.send_file
claim: `flask.helpers.send_file` sends the contents of a file to the client, and does not force a download unless `as_attachment` is true.
truth: Only the path_or_file type annotation changed. The passage stays true.

subject: update helpers.send_from_directory docstring
claim: `flask.helpers.send_from_directory` resolves `path` beneath `directory` and raises a 404 `NotFound` when the resolved file does not exist.
truth: Only a security note was added to the docstring. The passage stays true.

subject: fix mypy finding
claim: `flask.helpers.stream_with_context` keeps the request context alive for the duration of a streaming response, and works either as a decorator or applied directly to a generator.
truth: Only a type: ignore comment changed. The passage stays true.

subject: fix mypy finding
claim: `flask.app.Flask.make_response` extends the response's existing headers with any headers the view returned, rather than replacing them.
truth: Only a type: ignore comment was added on the update call. The passage stays true.

subject: fix typing
claim: `flask.app.Flask.process_response` runs the registered `after_request` callbacks in reverse order and then saves the session, unless the session interface reports a null session.
truth: The session is read through an accessor instead of an attribute. Behaviour, and the passage, are unchanged.

subject: Added python type annotation and return type.
claim: `flask.sansio.app.App` takes an `import_name` and passes the static and template configuration through to `flask.sansio.scaffold.Scaffold`.
truth: Only a -> None return annotation was added to __init__. The passage stays true.

subject: fix jinja_loader annotation
claim: `flask.sansio.scaffold.Scaffold.jinja_loader` is a cached property, and is `None` when `template_folder` is not set.
truth: Only the declared return type widened. The runtime behaviour the passage describes is unchanged.

subject: fix super call in list comprehension
claim: `flask.cli.SeparatedPathType` splits an environment variable on the OS path separator and converts each item the way `click.Path` would.
truth: The super() call was hoisted out of a comprehension for Python 3.11. Same behaviour, same passage.

subject: fix mypy finding
claim: `flask.sessions.SecureCookieSessionInterface.save_session` signs the session with `get_signing_serializer` and sets the cookie with the expiry from `get_expiration_time`.
truth: Only two type: ignore comments changed. The passage stays true.

subject: fix mypy finding with new werkzeug endpoint type
claim: `flask.wrappers.Request.endpoint` is the name of the URL rule that matched, and `None` when no rule matched.
truth: Only a type: ignore comment was added on the return. The passage stays true.

subject: Fix misrendered docstring
claim: `flask.config.Config.from_mapping` updates the config from a mapping, ignoring any key that is not upper-case, and always returns `True`.
truth: Only docstring line wrapping changed. The passage stays true.

subject: update ruff hook and noqa
claim: `flask.sessions.NullSession` fails on every write operation, raising a `RuntimeError` that tells you to set the secret key.
truth: Only noqa comments were removed. The passage stays true.
